_comment: Rates in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. cache_write = 1.25x input (5-min TTL), cache_read = 0.10x input, UNLESS overridden below with a rate sourced directly from https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/. Single source of truth for the menu bar app.
_ttl_note: Anthropic cache_write assumes the default 5-minute ephemeral TTL (1.25x input); Claude Code uses 5-min, not the pricier 1h tier. OpenAI's Bedrock cache_write is a 30-min TTL and is priced/sourced separately per model below.
_context_window_note: OpenAI gpt-5.6-* tiers on Bedrock price short (<=272K) and long (>1M) context separately; we only see the model name in transcripts, not which context window was used, so 'sol'/'terra'/'luna' below use the SHORT-context rate. A long-context call is undercounted (up to ~2x) until this is refined.
_match_note: Resolution order: (1) 'models' — longest model-string-substring match (so 'openai.gpt-5.4' matches key 'gpt-5.4'), for a confirmed rate that deviates from its family (e.g. a temporary sale, or a legacy non-tiered release); (2) 'families' — model string contains a tier codename ('opus'/'sonnet'/'haiku'/'fable' for Anthropic, 'sol'/'terra'/'luna' for OpenAI's gpt-5.6 line), so a brand-new dated or point release in a known tier still prices sanely without a code change; (3) 'default' — last-resort fallback for a wholly unrecognized family.

haiku._note: unconfirmed vs Bedrock — that page's Haiku 4.5 row is client-rendered, digits not visible in raw HTML

fable._note: unconfirmed vs Bedrock — same client-rendering issue as Haiku above

sol._source: aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing GPT-5.6 Sol, short context (272K), US East

terra._source: aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing GPT-5.6 Terra, short context (272K), US East

luna._source: aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing GPT-5.6 Luna, short context (272K), US East

claude-sonnet-5._note: on sale through at least 2026-08-31 per aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing — confirm and update/remove after

gpt-5.4._note: legacy non-tiered GPT release, no tier codename to match a family; no separate cache-write price listed on Bedrock so cache_write defaults to the input rate

gpt-5.5._note: legacy non-tiered GPT release, same no-cache-write-price caveat as gpt-5.4
